content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Blackthorn | Scheduled Jobs ## slug: blackthorn-scheduled-jobs ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End You can find the scheduled jobs below in Setup. In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Scheduled Jobs". All of the Payments job names start with Blackthorn | Payments. * **Blackthorn | Payments Send Stripe Invoices** - It runs at 6 am each day to send the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} to the customer when {{variable.Field_Invoice_SendOnDate}} = "TODAY" on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. * **Blackthorn | Payments Past Due Invoices** - It runs at 5 am each day to update the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} = "Past Due" when the Due Date < Today and {{variable.Field_Invoice_PaymentStatus}} = "Unpaid". You can schedule the jobs listed above by clicking the **Schedule Billing Jobs** button in the Blackthorn | Payment Admin tab. ## Process Stripe Billing Webhook Types Asynchronously {{snippet.Webhooks_ProcessSBwebhookTypesAsync}}
